summary:
I re-read the rework (5e510e1..1476f38) against the tree as it now stands. Each of the eight review findings sent back is fixed in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1:
- Invoke-W001StoppedRun treats an attempt with no report or a non-zero exit as a failure on the spot (6706-6710), and the post-loop 'none was partial' inconclusive is skipped for it (6730).
- Test-W001 starts the stopped run only after a Completed finished run (6908-6909).
- Test-W002 no longer checks for Completed unconditionally.
- Test-W003Real fails when Stop was pressed and the app reached no stopped ending (7223-7225), and a refused marker is now Inconclusive (7212).
- Get-W001RootShape and Seam.AppRoot follow LongPath.NormalizeRoot.
- Get-ProofRecordPath takes the letter from the root's own drive part.
- $wholeDrive now follows the shape.

What I ran:
- 76 tests: W001*, W002*, W003*, WindowCasesHelperTests, ArchitectureRulesTests and RuleCopiesAgreeTests, including the eight repros and the root-spelling corpus. All passed.
- Fitness: every rule holds. The docs/proof-runs rule matches no file yet, which is expected until a record is committed.
- The SUBST end-to-end wrapper, run again on the changed code: the finished part held, the stopped run was partial at 18,002 folders with sized '-' and held, the record held no path, nothing was written under .taad, and cleanup was complete.

What I did not run:
- The full suite. The engine's untracked .taad-scratch is in the tree, and AppArgumentTests trips on it (lesson #889).
- The rules harness, as before.

The only new item is a stale comment: Test-W001's header still says a second run 'follows' with -Stopped, but it now runs only after a Completed finished run. The two waived items (N-035, N-036) are unchanged in the code, as their waivers decided.

Second round: This round I went back over the changed code trying to break it, and I found nothing new to file.

**Parsers, matchers and readers**
- **Read-ActedLine and Get-StopToEndingMs.** The folder count and the sized value are both read before `current=`, so a path in `current=` cannot supply them. The time is anchored at the end of the line, and both forms of the hook's acted line parse. Integers come from interpolated longs, which never carry group separators.
- **The hook log** is read with Get-Content, which strips CRLF and any BOM.
- **Read-YamlEntry** reads plain and single-quoted must_not_match scalars. The engine-appended patterns contain no ` #` and no flow indicator that would change their YAML reading. Fitness read them the same way, and every rule holds.
- **Write-W001Record and the fitness rule.** A Windows message with an embedded line break cannot put `\r\n` into a record and trip the rule: UnreadableRows.OneLine folds line breaks into one space before a reason ever reaches the writer.
- **Get-CountsOnly** drops any DateTime that ConvertFrom-Json produces, so no date string reaches the writer.

**Boundaries**
- **Get-W001RootShape and Seam.AppRoot** follow LongPath.NormalizeRoot on:
  - the bare drive, `/` and trailing `\.` spellings, the `\\?\` and `\\?\UNC\` forms, and lower-case prefixes;
  - empty, whitespace and relative roots, which both refuse;
  - non-ASCII drive letters, which both end in a refusal, despite IsLetter in one against IsAsciiLetter in the other.
- **Device paths and volume-GUID paths** are outside the corpus's stated bound.
- **Get-ProofRecordPath** reads the letter only from the root's own drive part.

**Error paths**
- An abnormal stop attempt now fails at once.
- A non-zero app exit always means no report (App.xaml.cs discards it on a crash), so the new check message's 'no report' is accurate.
- The W-003 rig path where a precondition fails after Stop calls Inconclusive and still runs the row checks. That is the same shape as N-005's existing logic (5931-5936), not something this slice introduced.

**Lock and gap**
- The only check made before slow work and acted on after it is the -Force/stopped-part guard. It is checked before the scan, which can take an hour, and the record is written after. Only a second W-001 writing the same file during that hour could get past it, which I judged too unlikely to file.

**Run this pass**
- The tests named W001*, W002* and W003*, WindowCasesHelperTests, ArchitectureRulesTests and RuleCopiesAgreeTests: 76 of 76 passed.
- The SUBST end-to-end wrapper, re-run on the changed code: all checks held.

findings.claim: Test-W001's header says 'With -Stopped a second run follows'. Since the m2 fix, the second run follows only when the finished run ended Completed (6908-6909). Otherwise the case prints 'no stopped run: the finished run did not end Completed' and writes no stopped part.
findings.evidence: WindowCases.ps1:6908 `if ($Stopped -and [string]$run.Report.core.status -ceq 'Completed') { Invoke-W001StoppedRun ... }` and 6909 `elseif ($Stopped) { Write-Output '        no stopped run: the finished run did not end Completed' }`.
findings.fix: Reword the sentence to 'With -Stopped, and only when this run ended Completed, a second run follows: ...', adding that otherwise no stopped part is written.
